name: Anu LMS Example: Component override
description: Example module showing how to override an existing Anu LMS React component by swapping in rebuilt bundles.
project_description: Example submodule of Anu LMS (package 'Anu LMS Examples'). Demonstrates overriding an existing Anu LMS React component by implementing hook_library_info_alter to repoint the anu_lms JS libraries (js/dist/*) at this module's own compiled bundles, so a project can replace a stock component with a customised build. A copy-and-adapt developer template, not for production.
